One app. Your choice of phone.

Use Carpe Noctum through your browser or a Home Screen icon. The Android APK remains an optional installer.

Open Carpe Noctum

Scan with your phone camera to open the same app on Android or iPhone.

Choose your phone

Android browser or Home Screen

Use Chrome. Open the app, wait for Ready for offline use, then optionally install a Home Screen icon.

Android / no APK instructions

iPhone or iPad

Use Safari. Open the app, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the icon online until the offline copy is ready.

iPhone instructions

The same app address works on both platforms. Android technicians may also use the APK from the coworker package. The APK and website use separate job storage.

Keep a project backup

Choose Files → Back up project and finish your phone's save action. To move work between the APK, browser or another device, choose Files → Open project at the destination and verify the route and attachments. Keep one window open at a time.

Before field use, wait for Ready for offline use on Home, then reopen the same browser/icon in Airplane Mode. Manufacturer links need a connection.

Read the full technician guide

Start at the actual launch output

In Route → Setup, choose Node output, Amplifier / LE output, or Manual / other output. Select the exact equipment and port, then enter actual launch levels and only the remaining test-point correction.

Choose Source setup & manual, or Route → Equipment setup, then continue to cable route, sweep, readings and evidence. Source selection does not automatically change your levels. Export a project before updating and verify saved work afterward.
